_comment: Snapshot of expected hub test counts. Updated when intentionally adding/removing tests. CI fails if actual drifts beyond tolerance.
captured_from: per-file-isolated `bun run check-baseline` (each hub/test file in its own process — order-independent). Phase 20 (telegram-transcript-tail) adds 7 hub test files: transcript-backend-agnostic, transcript-adapter-claude, transcript-adapter-codex, telegram-output-from-transcript, telegram-permission-failclosed, telegram-permission-disambiguation, telegram-keystroke-inject, pty-turn-lock, telegram-human-only-guard (replacing the obsolete event-bus telegram-bridge.test.ts). pass/total here are informational; the enforced gate is pass_min/skip_max/fail_max. fail_max stays 0.

tolerance._comment: Allow modest growth without churn; any fail > 0 always fails CI. skip_max raised to 175 for Phase 22 (orchestrator-queue) env-gated (REMO_E2E_DB_URL) e2e skips, matching the Phase 21 data-model e2e gating. Raised to 178 for the feedback-intake key-ownership e2e (REMO_E2E_DB_URL-gated, BLOCKER-1 regression). Raised to 200 for milestone OEE (orchestrator-e2e-proveout): ~9 REMO_E2E_DB_URL-gated e2e test files (harness smoke, queue/lock, due-rows→waves, macro-cycle, cost-cap, notify, verify-tail, legacy-wave) that describe.skip cleanly in CI without a disposable Postgres.
